subject: Pairwise comparisons of directional asymmetry in GMM

messages.author: 96a78639336ed702
messages.subject: Pairwise comparisons of directional asymmetry in GMM
parts:
Dear all,

It is know that fluctuating asymmetry score can be calculated for groups and the difference in FA score among groups can be tested using the morphol.disparity function in geomorph. I am wondering does there exist directional asymmetry score, which is the equivalent of FA score for directional asymmetry, and how can I compare the level of directional asymmetry among several groups in geomorph or any other GMM software.

Best regards,
Patrick
